definition.crash: hourly close falls >=50% below peak close within 168h of peak
definition.onset: UTC hour of largest 1h close-to-close drop between peak and -50% crossing
definition.baselines: uniform; per-token-normalised GeckoTerminal hourly volume share of the same sample; candle-activity share

catalog_ath_dow.note: ATH date (UTC day) from CoinGecko; peak day, not hourly onset

billing.guard: patterns_common.http() raises before any request to nansen.ai / x.com / twitter.com; NANSEN_API_KEY and X_BEARER_TOKEN popped from env
